_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Node-owned route prefixes in the coexist split.
Consumed by BOTH apps/web/vite.config.mjs (dev/preview proxy) AND the Python
front door (apps/api reverse proxy, packages/superclaw/node_routes.py). Keeping
one neutral checked-in manifest is how dev and production/desktop never drift.
Order is significant: more specific Node prefixes (e.g. /v1/skills) MUST appear
and be matched before the Python catch-alls (/v1, /api). Consumers preserve this
array order. Every prefix here is routed to the vendored Node control plane
(server/server); everything not listed falls through to the Python backend.
prefix  (required) URL prefix owned by Node. Matched as a path-prefix.
rewrite (optional)  { from: <JS/py regex>, to: <str> } applied to the path
ws      (optional)  true when the prefix carries a WebSocket upgrade.
sse     (optional)  { method, path } of a streaming (text/event-stream)
endpoint under this prefix the front door must not buffer.
note    (optional)  human context; ignored by consumers.

nodeRoutes.note: Embedded board control plane + its live-updates WebSocket (Node /api/companies/:id/events/ws).
Plugin UI bytes served by Node at root-level /_plugins/:id/ui/* (plugin-ui-static.ts), not under /api.
Chat coexistence surface (Node engine). /api/chat/stream is a text/event-stream SSE endpoint.
Semantic cutover: Python also serves this; the front door routes it to Node.
